description.value:
You settle into an aggressive stance. Until the end of your turn, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and each time you move within 5 feet of a creature for the first time this turn, you may make one melee weapon attack against it. A hit deals an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type, and forces a Strength save on the target — on a failure, you may knock it prone or push it 5 feet away from you.

Force Potency. Cast with a force slot of 5th level or higher, the bonus weapon damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.
